# Daily Report — 2026-09-09

## Task Completed
Added `update_pa_dashboard`, `delete_pa_dashboard`, `update_pa_breakdown`, and `delete_pa_breakdown` tools to complete PA CRUD coverage.

- **update_pa_dashboard** — PATCH pa_home_page/{sys_id}; accepts title, description, active, order, owner; sys_id or exact-title lookup via existing resolver; empty-body guard; returns updated dashboard record.
- **delete_pa_dashboard** — DELETE pa_home_page/{sys_id}; handles 204/200 success and 404 guard; sys_id or title lookup.
- **update_pa_breakdown** — PATCH pa_breakdown/{sys_id}; accepts name, active, table, field, filter_condition; sys_id or exact-name lookup; empty-body guard; returns updated breakdown record.
- **delete_pa_breakdown** — DELETE pa_breakdown/{sys_id}; handles 204/200 success and 404 guard; sys_id or name lookup.

All four tools registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, and `config/tool_packages.yaml` (system_administrator + full packages). Four new Pydantic param models added (`UpdatePADashboardParams`, `DeletePADashboardParams`, `UpdatePABreakdownParams`, `DeletePABreakdownParams`).
